title: Social Media Executive
description:
**Company:** GYM Line Plus  
**Department:** Marketing  
**Job Title:** Social Media & Digital Marketing Executive  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Delhi NCR

1. Job Summary

GYM Line Plus is looking for a creative and result-oriented Social Media & Digital Marketing Executive to manage the company's online presence, execute digital advertising campaigns, generate business leads, and increase sales. The candidate will be responsible for social media management, paid advertising, brand promotion, and performance marketing across Meta, Google, and Amazon platforms.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Social Media Management

* Manage the company's social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and LinkedIn.
* Plan and execute monthly content calendars, including reels, posts, stories, product promotions, and campaigns.
* Create engaging content to promote gym equipment, fitness products, and company services.
* Coordinate with the design and video teams for product shoots, promotional videos, and creatives.
* Monitor audience engagement, respond to customer enquiries, and improve brand visibility.

B. Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram Ads)

* Plan, create, and manage paid advertising campaigns through Meta Ads Manager.
* Generate qualified leads and enquiries for gym equipment and fitness products.
* Develop audience targeting, retargeting, and remarketing strategies.
* Monitor advertising budgets and optimize campaigns to reduce cost per lead and increase conversions.
* Analyze campaign performance and implement improvements.

C. Google Ads

* Create and manage Google Search, Display, Shopping, and YouTube campaigns, as applicable.
* Conduct keyword research to attract customers searching for gym equipment and fitness solutions.
* Optimize campaigns to increase website traffic, enquiries, and sales.
* Monitor Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and advertising performance.
* Manage campaign budgets and improve return on advertising spend.

D. Amazon Ads & E-commerce Marketing

* Manage Amazon advertising campaigns, including Sponsored Products and other applicable ad formats.
* Optimize product listings, keywords, and advertising campaigns to improve visibility and sales.
* Monitor product performance, advertising spend, ACOS, and ROAS.
* Coordinate with the e-commerce team on product promotions, offers, and campaigns.
* Identify opportunities to increase online product sales and improve advertising efficiency.

E. Lead Generation & Sales Growth

* Develop digital marketing strategies to generate leads for gym equipment, fitness products, and commercial gym setup projects.
* Coordinate with the sales team to follow up on leads and improve conversion rates.
* Support B2B marketing activities targeting gyms, fitness studios, hotels, residential societies, and commercial fitness centres.
* Track leads, enquiries, orders, and revenue generated through digital channels.
* Work towards monthly lead generation, sales, and revenue targets.

F. Performance Analysis & Reporting

* Prepare weekly and monthly digital marketing reports.
* Track impressions, clicks, leads, conversions, cost per lead, sales, and ROAS.
* Monitor competitors, market trends, and customer preferences.
* Recommend strategies to improve campaign performance and marketing ROI.
* Ensure effective utilization of advertising budgets.

3. Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Digital Marketing, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in digital marketing and social media management.
* Practical experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Knowledge of Amazon Ads and e-commerce platforms.
* Understanding of SEO, keyword research, Google Analytics, and conversion tracking.
* Strong analytical, communication, and campaign management skills.
* Ability to generate leads and support sales growth through digital channels.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Qualified leads generated per month.
* Cost per lead and customer acquisition cost.
* Growth in online enquiries and sales revenue.
* Return on advertising spend (ROAS).
* Social media reach, engagement, and audience growth.
* Website traffic and conversion rate.
* Achievement of monthly marketing targets.

5. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be creative, data-driven, and sales-focused, with an understanding of the fitness industry and gym equipment market. Experience in B2B lead generation, e-commerce marketing, and performance advertising will be an added advantage.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
Job Description: UGC Content Creator

**Company:** Inquiry Bazaar Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Title:** UGC Content Creator  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Location:** Netaji Subhas Place Delhi 110034  
**Department:** Marketing / Content  
**Reporting To:** Marketing Head / Content Manager

About Inquiry Bazaar Pvt. Ltd.

Inquiry Bazaar Pvt. Ltd. is a growing business focused on helping brands and businesses generate quality inquiries, improve their digital presence, and connect with potential customers.

We are looking for a **creative, confident, and social-media-savvy UGC Content Creator** who can create engaging short-form content that feels authentic, relatable, and native to platforms such as Instagram and YouTube.

Job Overview

As a **UGC Content Creator**, you will be responsible for creating short-form video content that promotes our brand, services, campaigns, and marketing initiatives.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable **facing the camera, speaking naturally, creating hooks, following trends, and converting marketing messages into engaging content**.

You will work closely with the marketing and creative teams to develop content concepts, scripts, reels, testimonials, product/service explainers, and promotional videos.

Key ResponsibilitiesContent Creation

* Create engaging UGC-style videos for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and other digital platforms.
* Appear on camera and communicate confidently and naturally.
* Create videos based on provided briefs, scripts, concepts, and campaign objectives.
* Develop relatable and authentic content rather than overly promotional content.
* Create different content formats including:
* Talking-head videos
* Explainer videos
* Testimonials
* Problem-solution videos
* Product/service demonstrations
* Educational content
* Trend-based Reels
* Promotional videos
* FAQ videos
* Customer-perspective videos
* Behind-the-scenes content

Content Ideation

* Research current Instagram/YouTube trends, formats, hooks, sounds, and content styles.
* Generate fresh UGC concepts and content ideas.
* Understand the target audience and create content that resonates with them.
* Develop strong opening hooks to capture attention within the first few seconds.
* Suggest creative approaches for improving engagement and retention.

Script & Presentation

* Understand and execute short-form video scripts.
* Convert marketing briefs into simple, conversational language.
* Deliver dialogues naturally instead of sounding scripted.
* Experiment with different tones, storytelling styles, hooks, and CTAs.
* Provide multiple takes when required.

Shooting & Basic Production

* Record high-quality videos using a smartphone or camera.
* Maintain good lighting, framing, audio, background, and overall presentation.
* Coordinate with the editing team or perform basic editing when required.
* Ensure videos meet platform-specific requirements such as aspect ratio, duration, captions, and visual quality.

Social Media & Trends

* Stay updated with current social-media trends.
* Monitor competitor and industry content.
* Identify trending formats that can be adapted to the company's brand.
* Maintain awareness of what performs well on Reels and Shorts.
* Track content performance and use insights to improve future videos.

Collaboration

* Work with the marketing, performance marketing, design, and content teams.
* Participate in content planning and brainstorming sessions.
* Take feedback positively and make revisions when required.
* Maintain a consistent content schedule.

Required Skills

* Excellent communication skills.
* Strong confidence in front of the camera.
* Natural and expressive presentation style.
* Good understanding of Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
* Ability to create strong hooks and CTAs.
* Good storytelling ability.
* Creativity and willingness to experiment.
* Basic understanding of social-media trends.
* Ability to follow scripts while maintaining a natural delivery.
* Good sense of body language, expressions, and presentation.
* Basic knowledge of mobile video shooting and editing is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in Marketing, Mass Communication, Journalism, Media, Advertising, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.
* Previous experience creating Reels, Shorts, UGC, influencer content, or social-media videos will be an advantage.
* Candidates with a strong personal Instagram/YouTube portfolio are encouraged to apply.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

* **Loves being in front of the camera.**
* Can speak confidently and naturally.
* Understands what makes people stop scrolling.
* Is comfortable experimenting with different content styles.
* Can turn a simple idea into an engaging video.
* Is energetic, creative, and proactive.
* Can handle feedback and improve quickly.
* Is genuinely interested in social media and content creation.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number and consistency of quality videos produced.
* Content quality and creativity.
* Audience engagement.
* Video watch time and retention.
* Reels/Shorts reach and views.
* Quality of hooks and CTAs.
* Ability to meet content deadlines.
* Improvement based on performance data and feedback.
* Contribution of content toward brand awareness and marketing objectives.

Experience

**Freshers:** Can apply if they have strong communication skills and confidence on camera.

**Experienced candidates:** 1–2 years of experience in UGC, influencer marketing, social-media content, video creation, or a related field will be preferred.

What You Will Get

* Opportunity to work on real marketing campaigns.
* Exposure to digital marketing and performance marketing.
* Opportunity to build a professional content portfolio.
* Creative and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunity to experiment with different content formats.
* Growth opportunities within the marketing team.

Salary

depending on experience, communication skills, content-creation ability, and overall fit.

*Salary can be discussed based on the candidate's experience and portfolio.*

How to Apply

Interested candidates should share:

* Updated CV/Resume.
* Instagram/YouTube profile, if available.
* Portfolio or previous UGC/Reel/Shorts samples.
* 2–3 examples of videos they have created.

**Subject:** Application for UGC Content Creator – Inquiry Bazaar Pvt. Ltd.

Important Note for Candidates

This is a **camera-facing content creation role**. Candidates should be comfortable appearing in videos and communicating directly with the audience.

We are more interested in **confidence, creativity, communication, authenticity, and content sense** than expensive equipment or highly polished production.

title: AI Marketing Associate - Apprentice
description:
### **Description**

**Job Title:** Human Resources Associate- Apprentice

**Location:** DLF Cyber Hub, Gurugram

**About the Program**

The Eptura Apprenticeship Program is designed to provide recent graduates and early-career professionals with meaningful, hands-on experience within a global SaaS organization. Throughout this 12-month program, apprentices will receive mentoring, structured learning opportunities, and exposure to commercial operations and sales processes.

**Eligibility**

To be considered for this apprenticeship, candidates must:

* Have completed a Bachelor's degree within the past two years
* Have no more than two years of professional work experience
* Be legally eligible to participate in an apprenticeship program in India

**Shape the Future of Work with Eptura**

At Eptura, we're not just another tech company—we're a global leader transforming the way people, workplaces, and assets connect. Our innovative worktech solutions empower 25 million users across 115 countries to thrive in a digitally connected world. Trusted by 45% of Fortune 500 companies, we're redefining workplace innovation and driving success for organizations around the globe.

**Role Overview**  
  
As an AI Marketing Apprentice, you will work alongside our marketing, product marketing, and sales teams to help build the next generation of AI-powered marketing. You'll learn how to create and train AI agents, automate repetitive marketing tasks, generate personalized content, produce videos, and support sales teams with customized customer presentations. This role is designed for an early-career professional, recent graduate, or career starter who wants hands-on experience at the intersection of marketing, AI, automation, and content creation.

### **Responsibilities**

  

* Build and test AI agents using Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio.
* Train AI agents using approved product messaging, sales content, customer insights, and brand guidelines.
* Assist in creating social media posts, blogs, emails, and campaign content using AI tools.
* Develop customized sales presentations tailored to specific customers, industries, and buyer personas.
* Produce short-form and long-form videos for social media, product launches, webinars, and internal communications.
* Create brand-compliant images, graphics, animations, and multimedia assets using generative AI tools.
* Research competitors, market trends, and customer needs using AI-powered analytics.
* Assist in creating executive presentations, thought leadership content, and customer-facing materials.
* Analyze campaign, website, and social media performance and generate actionable insights.
* Test and improve AI-generated content for accuracy, quality, and brand consistency.
* Support sales and marketing teams by creating enablement content, battlecards, and customer communications.
* Build and maintain knowledge libraries that improve AI agent performance over time.
* Experiment with new AI tools, prompting techniques, and automation approaches.
* Partner with marketing, product, sales, and customer success teams to identify opportunities for AI-driven efficiency.
* Present recommendations, findings, and AI project outcomes to marketing leadership.
* Stay current on emerging AI technologies, content creation trends, and Microsoft Copilot capabilities.

Within your first year, you will:

* Build and improve AI agents for marketing and sales teams.
* Create content that is actively used across campaigns and customer engagements.
* Produce engaging social and video content.
* Help automate repeatable marketing workflows.
* Develop expertise in Microsoft's AI ecosystem.
* Build a portfolio of real-world AI, marketing, and content creation projects

  

### **About You**

We're looking for a motivated self-starter who is keen to build a career in marketing or technology. The following will set you up for success in this role:

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* High attention to detail and a methodical approach to organizing information.
* Strong interest in AI, marketing technology, and automation.
* Comfortable learning new technologies and software platforms.
* Demonstrated interest in content creation, social media, video production, or digital marketing.
* Experience using Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 applications.
* Experience creating social media, video, or digital content.
* Basic video editing experience using Canva, Adobe Express, Clipchamp, Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar tools.
* Experience with PowerPoint and visual storytelling.
* Portfolio of content, videos, presentations, or creative projects.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Monthly stipend of 21,000 INR
* Health Insurance fully paid – Self
* 13 Public Holidays
* Paid Time off
* Hybrid and Remote working
* Exposure to the latest trends and technologies in the SaaS industry.
* Mentorship from global experienced professionals in the marketing, sales, renewals and customer success fields.
* Potential for career advancement based on performance and dedication.

**Eptura Information:**

* Follow us on Twitter | LinkedIn | Facebook | YouTube
* At Eptura, we believe strong teams are built through collaboration, flexibility, and a range of perspectives grounded in skill and experience. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work, contribute meaningfully, and grow alongside our business.

**After the Apprenticeship**

The apprenticeship is a **12-month development program**. Successful completion does not guarantee permanent employment; however, apprentices may be considered for future opportunities based on performance, business needs, and the availability of approved positions.

### **About Eptura**

Ready to make a difference? Explore opportunities with Eptura and join us on this incredible journey.  
  
Joining Eptura means becoming part of a forward-thinking, dynamic team that's on a mission to shape a better, more connected future. We're seeking passionate, driven individuals who want to make a real impact and be at the forefront of workplace innovation.

At Eptura, we believe strong teams are built through collaboration, flexibility, and a range of perspectives grounded in skill and experience. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work, contribute meaningfully, and grow alongside our business.

**Social Media Management & Content Publishing**

**Video Editing & Content Production**

* Edit promotional videos, product videos, social media reels, YouTube videos, Shorts, and advertising creatives.
* Add transitions, motion graphics, text animations, subtitles, sound effects, music, and other relevant elements.
* Adapt videos into different aspect ratios and formats for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and advertising campaigns.
* Create engaging video content suitable for brand awareness, audience engagement, and lead generation.
* Ensure professional output quality, correct branding, and timely delivery.
* Use **Adobe Premiere Pro** and other professional video editing tools where required.

**Google Ads & Paid Advertising**

* Set up, manage, monitor, and optimize Google Ads campaigns.
* Work with Search Ads, Display Ads, YouTube Ads, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign types based on client objectives.
* Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor analysis, and negative keyword management.
* Prepare ad copy, headlines, descriptions, extensions/assets, and landing page recommendations.

* Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, targeting, and audience segmentation.
* Analyse impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions, CPA, and ROAS where applicable.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance and reduce wasted advertising spend.

**Meta Ads — Facebook & Instagram**

* Create, manage, and optimise campaigns through Meta Ads Manager.
* Handle lead generation, website traffic, engagement, reach, remarketing, and sales campaigns.
* Set up campaign objectives, audiences, placements, budgets, ad sets, and advertisements.
* Develop and test different ad creatives, copy, headlines, offers, and audience segments.
* Work with Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and conversion events where applicable.
* Monitor CPL, CPC, CTR, CPM, conversion rates, and ROAS where applicable.
* Analyse campaign results and make data-driven decisions to improve lead generation and overall advertising performance.
* Coordinate with clients and the internal team to improve lead quality and campaign outcomes.

**Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)**

* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Perform on-page SEO, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URL structure, internal linking, and content optimisation.
* Identify technical SEO issues and coordinate website improvements where required.
* Work on off-page SEO, backlink analysis, and ethical link-building activities.
* Optimise website content for search visibility, relevant keywords, and user intent.
* Use Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and other SEO tools to monitor website performance.
* Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, indexing issues, and SEO progress.
* Prepare regular SEO reports and recommend actionable improvements.

**Content Strategy & Website Management**

* Research client industries, target audiences, competitors, and current market trends.
* Develop content ideas and marketing strategies aligned with client goals.
* Write or coordinate website content, blogs, landing page copy, promotional messages, and campaign content.
* Make routine website content updates and coordinate with developers for technical changes.
* Ensure consistent messaging and branding across social media, websites, advertisements, and other digital channels.

**Analytics, Reporting & Client Coordination**

* Prepare monthly content calendars, campaign reports, and digital marketing performance summaries.
* Use Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Ads reports, and Meta Ads Manager to analyse results.
* Track key performance indicators such as reach, engagement, traffic, leads, conversions, CPL, and ROAS where applicable.
* Identify performance gaps and recommend improvements based on actual campaign data.
* Coordinate with the design, development, and sales teams to ensure smooth campaign execution.
* Manage multiple client accounts, campaign deadlines, revisions, and deliverables simultaneously.

**Required Technical Skills :**

* **Social Media:** Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and relevant publishing tools.
* **Paid Advertising:** Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, campaign setup, targeting, optimisation, and reporting.
* **Graphic Design:** Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.
* **Video Editing:** Adobe Premiere Pro; knowledge of After Effects is an advantage.
* **SEO:** Keyword research, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, technical SEO fundamentals, and competitor analysis.
* **Analytics:** Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking fundamentals.
* **Content:** Copywriting, captions, ad copy, content calendars, and platform-specific content planning.
* **Reporting:** Excel or Google Sheets and campaign performance analysis.

**Eligibility & Experience :**

* 1-2 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing preferred.
* Freshers with strong practical skills, a relevant portfolio, and knowledge of digital marketing tools may also apply.
* Candidates must be comfortable handling multiple client accounts and managing different marketing activities simultaneously.
* A portfolio of social media creatives, edited videos, advertising campaigns, or SEO work will be an advantage.
* Good communication, organisational skills, attention to detail, and time management are essential.
* Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, accept feedback, and continuously improve campaign performance.

**Preferred Candidate Profile :**

We are looking for an all-round digital marketing professional who understands both the creative and performance sides of marketing.

The candidate should be capable of designing creatives, editing videos, managing social media publishing, executing SEO activities, running paid advertising campaigns, analysing results, and coordinating deliverables across multiple clients.

**Preference will be given to candidates with practical experience in Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Premiere Pro, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and SEO tools.**

* A collaborative working environment with scope for professional growth.

* Assists to conduct annual Performance Development Discussions with employees and to support them in their professional development goals.

* Assists to plan and implement effective training programmes for employees in coordination with the Training Manager and Departmental Trainers.

* Assists to prepare and post the weekly work schedules.

* Encourages employees to be creative and innovative, challenging and recognising them for their contribution to the success of the operation.

* Supports the implementation of The People Philosophy, demonstrating and reinforcing Hyatt’s Values and Culture Characteristics.

* Assists to feedback the results of the Employee Engagement Survey and ensure that the relevant changes are implemented.

* Assists to ensure that all employees deliver the brand promise and provide exceptional guest service at all times.

* Assists to ensure that employees also provide excellent service to internal customers in other departments as appropriate.

* Handles all guest and internal customer complaints and inquiries in a courteous and efficient manner, following through to make sure problems are resolved satisfactorily.

**Marketing**

**Other duties**

* Attends and contributes to all training sessions and meetings as required.

* Is knowledgeable in statutory legislation in employee and industrial relations.

* Exercises responsible behaviour at all times and positively representing the hotel team and Hyatt International.

* Maintains strong, professional relationship with the relevant representatives from competitor hotels, business partners and other organisations.

* Reads the hotel's Employee Handbook and have an understanding of and adhere to the hotel's rules and regulations and in particular, the policies and procedures relating to computer resources, fire, hygiene, health and safety.

* Ensures high standards of personal presentation and grooming.

* Responds to changes in the Food and Beverage function as dictated by the industry, company and hotel.

* Carries out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.

  

Leadership Profile:

  

Hyatt’s Leadership Profile clarifies what is expected of Hyatt’s leaders and the specific behaviors that successful leaders exhibit to achieve business results.

Be familiar with Hyatt’s Leadership Profile as the expectation and measure of your performance. Additionally, exhibiting these behaviors will help you hire, develop, evaluate and reward talent successfully.

  

**Learn & Grow**

Leaders are quick and curious. They are more likely than others to be energized by the challenge of the unfamiliar, to quickly understand new or complex situations and data, and to share that learning with others. They are also likely to be more open to feedback, to reflect and learn from experiences, and to recover quickly from setbacks. They probably also have a higher risk tolerance and greater resilience to recover from mistakes or failures than many of their peers. These behaviors and personal qualities are an advantage in becoming more effective as a leader over time.

  

**Foster a Culture of Care**

Leaders build trust through listening first, acting ethically and with integrity. They truly care about others and demonstrate that as they display empathy, create an inclusive environment, encourage diverse viewpoints, and recognize and reward excellence. They assume responsibility for the customer experience, prioritize stakeholder needs, and ensure colleagues have the resources and support they need to demonstrate to customers that we really care.

  

**Adapt and Thrive with Change**

Leaders look ahead and make needed changes happen. They are comfortable adapting or transforming existing processes or directions to customer needs, and are more proactive in identifying and removing barriers to change and engaging key internal stakeholders. They also tend to be aware of the broader business climate, able to connect trends in the external world to changes needed internally, and more likely to sponsor or coach teams driving change.

  

**Achieve Results**

Leaders are action-oriented, understand how to effectively work through others, and are undeterred by challenges. They move quickly to address issues and tend to be comfortable making decisions even when the right answer isn’t totally clear. They are more likely to set clear expectations for colleagues on their team, hold their team to higher performance standards, and give direct feedback. At the same time, they tend to provide support to their team in order to achieve the goals—communicating, coaching and developing, helping them connect their individual work to a greater goal, and entrusting them to act. They are also more likely to see the bigger picture, think longer-term about their team’s talent needs, and to take a longer-term view of results that count.

**About Hiverift Software Pvt. Ltd.**

Hiverift Software Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and results-driven SEO Manager with 4–7 years of experience to join our team .

The ideal candidate must have strong expertise in both National SEO (India) and International SEO, along with proven experience in technical SEO, keyword research, on-page and off-page optimization, content strategy, and organic growth.

The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing SEO strategies that improve search engine visibility, increase organic traffic, generate qualified leads, and drive business growth across national and international markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* SEO Strategy: Develop and implement SEO strategies for national and international websites based on business goals and target audiences.
* National SEO: Plan and execute SEO campaigns targeting Indian markets, including location-based keyword research, local search visibility, and relevant audience targeting.
* International SEO: Manage SEO campaigns for multiple countries and markets, including international keyword research, regional search intent, hreflang implementation, and country-specific optimization.
* Keyword Research: Conduct comprehensive keyword research, search intent analysis, keyword mapping, and competitor analysis.
* Technical SEO: Perform website audits, resolve crawling and indexing issues, optimize site architecture, improve Core Web Vitals, and implement structured data.
* On-Page SEO: Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, images, and website content.
* Off-Page SEO: Develop ethical link-building strategies, acquire quality backlinks, and improve domain authority and website credibility.
* Content Strategy: Collaborate with content writers to develop SEO-friendly blogs, landing pages, service pages, and topic clusters.
* Competitor Analysis: Analyze national and international competitors to identify keyword gaps, backlink opportunities, and growth strategies.
* Performance Monitoring: Track organic traffic, rankings, conversions, impressions, and click-through rates.
* SEO Reporting: Prepare regular performance reports and provide actionable recommendations based on data.
* Team Collaboration: Coordinate with content, development, and digital marketing teams to implement SEO improvements.
* Algorithm Updates: Stay updated on Google algorithm changes, search trends, and evolving SEO practices, including AI-driven search experiences.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 4–7 years of hands-on experience in Search Engine Optimization.
* Strong practical experience in National SEO and International SEO.
* Proven ability to plan and execute SEO campaigns for different geographical markets.
* Excellent knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
* Proficiency in Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
* Hands-on experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or equivalent SEO tools.
* Knowledge of international targeting, hreflang tags, canonicalization, and country-specific SEO strategies.
* Strong understanding of XML sitemaps, robots.txt, redirects, structured data, and website architecture.
* Experience with keyword research, backlink analysis, rank tracking, and competitor benchmarking.
* Familiarity with WordPress or other content management systems.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver measurable SEO results.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Growth in organic traffic across national and international markets.
* Improvement in keyword rankings and organic search visibility.
* Increase in qualified organic leads and conversions.
* Improvement in technical SEO health and website indexing.
* Growth in relevant, high-quality backlinks.
* Improvement in organic click-through rates and landing-page performance.
* Successful execution of national and international SEO strategies.
* Timely reporting and implementation of SEO action plans.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven success in improving organic visibility for competitive keywords.
* Experience handling SEO campaigns across multiple countries or regions.
* Experience with B2B, SaaS, software, IT services, or lead-generation websites.
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript rendering, and website development workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted SEO tools and emerging search technologies.

Kala Shree is a women's ethnic wear house in Karol Bagh, Delhi, known for bridal and festive lehengas. We sell to brides and families walking into our store (B2C) and to boutiques and retailers across India (B2B).

Today most brides discover their lehenga on Instagram before they ever visit a store. This role owns that first impression. You will build Kala Shree into a brand brides follow, trust and travel to, and you will be measured on enquiries and footfall, not just likes.

Area

Plan and direct in-store shoots, model shoots and bride try-on videos. Produce 4–5 Reels, 3–4 posts and daily Stories a week. Write captions in English and Hinglish.

Success is measured by qualified enquiries and store visits that come from social media.

Period

Days 31–60

Posting consistently on schedule. First influencer collab live. First Meta ad campaign running with cost-per-lead tracked.

Days 61–90

Clear month-on-month growth in enquiries. Library of 20+ real-bride testimonials. Monthly report reviewed with owner.

KPI

Qualified enquiries (DM, WhatsApp, calls)

Store visits from social

Sales influenced by social

Instagram Insights

Reel engagement rate

Likes + comments + shares + saves ÷ reach

DM response time

Under 2 working hours

Cost per lead on paid ads

Meta Ads Manager

New Google reviews

Google Business Profile

**Must have**

* 3–5 years running social media for a fashion, ethnic wear, bridal, jewellery or lifestyle brand
* A portfolio of Reels and campaigns you planned and shot yourself, with results
* Strong eye for Indian bridal aesthetics: colours, styling, lighting, poses
* Hands-on with mobile shooting and editing (CapCut, InShot, VN or Premiere Rush) and Canva
* Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Instagram Insights
* Clear writing in English and Hindi/Hinglish
* Comfortable on the shop floor talking to brides and families for content and testimonials
* Lives within easy commute of Karol Bagh

**Good to have**

* Experience with Delhi/NCR influencer and wedding-planner networks
* Basic photography with a DSLR/mirrorless camera
* Knowledge of WhatsApp Business, Google Business Profile and Pinterest
* Exposure to B2B or LinkedIn content
* Graduate in Mass Communication, Fashion Communication, Marketing or similar (skill matters more than degree)

What we offer

* Fixed monthly salary in the ₹30,000 – ₹50,000 band, based on experience and portfolio
* Monthly incentive linked to qualified enquiries and social-driven sales
* Phone/data allowance and a dedicated shoot setup (ring lights, gimbal, backdrop corner)
* Shoot budget for models, props and influencer collaborations
* Paid leave as per company policy, plus festival bonus
* Full creative ownership of the Kala Shree brand voice, with direct access to the owner
* Salary review after probation and annually

How to apply and hiring process

Send your CV, portfolio link (Instagram handles you managed + a Reels showreel) and current/expected salary to the Kala Shree hiring email or WhatsApp number.

* **Portfolio screen** — we shortlist on work samples and results, not just the CV.
* **Phone call (15 min)** — experience, salary expectations, notice period, commute.

description:
**Remote SEO Content Editor – AI Search & AEO**

Study.com is looking for an SEO Content Editor – AI Search & AEO. The role involves reviewing AI-generated drafts and refine them. We are looking for experienced professionals who can can edit, fact-check, review, and optimize content for Study.com's College Saver (college credit) and Test Prep products. This is a remote contractor role. All work is paid per hour.

**Project Description**

This role involves editing, fact-checking, reviewing, and optimizing content for Study.com's College Saver (college credit) and Test Prep products. You will review AI-generated drafts and refine them across five priorities:

* AI citation readiness
* Traditional SEO
* Readability
* Freshness
* Factual and product accuracy.

The goal is for these articles not only to rank in traditional search results, but also to be cited and surface in AI-powered search environments (e.g., Google AI Overviews and generative engines).

Success in this role requires a sharp editorial eye, a deep understanding of SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) principles, and the ability to turn AI drafts into accurate, publish-ready content.

**Responsibilities:**

* Editing AI-generated drafts for accuracy, clarity, readability, grammar, structure, brand voice, and alignment with the content brief
* Reviewing drafts for AI citation readiness (AEO/GEO) and traditional SEO, including answer-first structure, search intent alignment, header hierarchy, keyword integration, metadata, and internal linking
* Fact-checking claims, statistics, and college credit and test prep details (e.g., credit transfer policies, exam formats, dates, and fees) against authoritative sources
* Checking drafts for freshness by updating outdated dates, figures, policies, and exam changes so content reflects current information
* Ensuring College Saver and Test Prep product details, marketing claims, and messaging are accurate, compliant, and integrated naturally
* Catching common AI-draft issues such as hallucinated facts, outdated information, generic or repetitive phrasing, and unverified claims
* Flagging recurring issues in AI drafts and sharing feedback with the team to improve prompts and draft quality over time
* Auditing and optimizing existing published articles to improve rankings, visibility, and AI citation share
* Maintaining and enforcing style guide standards and editorial consistency across the content library
* Managing multiple drafts and deadlines within an editorial workflow

**Requirements:**

* *Availability to work with a minimum of 4 hours of overlap with Pacific Standard Time (PST)*
* 3 - 5+ years of professional experience editing SEO-driven content
* Hands-on experience optimizing content for Google AI Overviews or AI search (e.g., ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini)
* Proven experience editing AI-generated content and managing content through an editorial workflow
* Experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to support editing, fact-checking, and optimization, while maintaining strong editorial judgment and human oversight
* Expert copyediting skills with exceptional attention to grammar, clarity, and consistency
* Working knowledge of a major style guide (e.g., AP or Chicago) and the ability to apply a house style guide
* Demonstrated success improving content that drives organic traffic, backlinks, and engagement
* Deep understanding of on-page SEO best practices, including:
  + Keyword research and search intent alignment
  + Competitor analysis and SERP evaluation
  + Strategic header structure (H1–H3 hierarchy)
  + Metadata optimization (title tags, meta descriptions)
  + Internal linking strategies
  + Readability optimization and user experience considerations
* Ability to spot keyword stuffing, redundancy, and thin content, and fix it without sacrificing quality or authority
* Excellent written and spoken English skills

*Nice to Haves:*

* Experience managing, coaching, or onboarding freelance writers and contractors
* Familiarity with SEO and AI visibility tools (e.g., Ahrefs, Semrush, Surfer, Profound) and the ability to interpret the data
* Experience in education, edtech, or other YMYL-adjacent content where accuracy and E-E-A-T matter
* Working knowledge of schema markup and structured data for AEO
* Experience building or refining briefs, editorial checklists, or style guides

**Required Skills:**

* **Education:** A Bachelor's Degree is mandatory
* **Experience:** 3-5 years of working experience in the same role.

  

**What We Offer:**

* **Reliable Payments:** You'll receive payments twice a month and automated invoicing for your work.
* **Remote Work:** This is a fully online contracted work-from-home opportunity.
* **Flexibility:** Basically, there are no requirements! Work when you want, where you want, as often as you want, with no minimums/maximums.
* **Support:** Our supportive staff is available answer your questions and help you get up and running.

**The Contract Process**

* Complete the application and submit with your resume.

* Applications are approved and contracts sent on Wednesdays.

* Submit the contract within the 5-day signing window.

* The following Wednesday, you'll receive onboarding instructions.

You can view a step-by-step overview of the contract process here: **How to Become a Freelancer with Study.com**

**About Study.com**

The mission of Study.com is to make education accessible, and over the last two decades we've become the leading online education platform, delivering a personalized learning experience across a broad continuum of education for over 30 million students, instructors, and professionals every month.

We help empower millions of learners to achieve their education and career goals. We focus on increasing access to education because we know information is the ultimate equalizer and that education is key to upward mobility.

**Leadership Profile:**

  

Hyatt’s Leadership Profile clarifies what is expected of Hyatt’s leaders and the specific behaviors that successful leaders exhibit to achieve business results.

Be familiar with Hyatt’s Leadership Profile as the expectation and measure of your performance. Additionally, exhibiting these behaviors will help you hire, develop, evaluate and reward talent successfully.

  

**Learn & Grow**

Leaders are quick and curious. They are more likely than others to be energized by the challenge of the unfamiliar, to quickly understand new or complex situations and data, and to share that learning with others. They are also likely to be more open to feedback, to reflect and learn from experiences, and to recover quickly from setbacks. They probably also have a higher risk tolerance and greater resilience to recover from mistakes or failures than many of their peers. These behaviors and personal qualities are an adsvantage in becoming more effective as a leader over time.

  

**Foster a Culture of Care**

Leaders build trust through listening first, acting ethically and with integrity. They truly care about others and demonstrate that as they display empathy, create an inclusive environment, encourage diverse viewpoints, and recognize and reward excellence. They assume responsibility for the customer experience, prioritize stakeholder needs, and ensure colleagues have the resources and support they need to demonstrate to customers that we really care.

  

**Adapt and Thrive with Change**

Leaders look ahead and make needed changes happen. They are comfortable adapting or transforming existing processes or directions to customer needs, and are more proactive in identifying and removing barriers to change and engaging key internal stakeholders. They also tend to be aware of the broader business climate, able to connect trends in the external world to changes needed internally, and more likely to sponsor or coach teams driving change.

  

**Achieve Results**

Leaders are action-oriented, understand how to effectively work through others, and are undeterred by challenges. They move quickly to address issues and tend to be comfortable making decisions even when the right answer isn’t totally clear. They are more likely to set clear expectations for colleagues on their team, hold their team to higher performance standards, and give direct feedback. At the same time, they tend to provide support to their team in order to achieve the goals—communicating, coaching and developing, helping them connect their individual work to a greater goal, and entrusting them to act. They are also more likely to see the bigger picture, think longer-term about their team’s talent needs, and to take a longer-term view of results that count.

description:

title: Email & WhatsApp Marketing Executive
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for an **Email & WhatsApp Marketing Executive** to execute outbound marketing campaigns that support lead generation, prospect follow-up, and re-engagement.

The role involves preparing and sending cold email and WhatsApp campaigns, organizing and segmenting contact lists, managing follow-up sequences, tracking responses, and maintaining accurate campaign records.

You will help generate relevant business enquiries through structured, well-organized outreach. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with prospect databases, following campaign processes, and maintaining professional, relevant communication across channels.

**Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.** Previous experience in email marketing, WhatsApp marketing, cold outreach, or lead generation is an advantage but is not mandatory.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare, schedule, and execute cold email and WhatsApp outreach campaigns using approved tools and processes.
* Organize, clean, and segment contact lists based on campaign requirements and target audiences.
* Execute follow-up sequences for prospects who have not responded or require further communication.
* Support re-engagement campaigns for suitable existing contacts.
* Maintain accurate records of messages sent, replies received, interested prospects, follow-up status, and campaign outcomes.
* Monitor responses and identify interested leads for further follow-up by the sales or business development team.

* Track campaign activity and basic performance metrics, such as delivery, replies, positive responses, and qualified enquiries, where available.
* Use spreadsheets, CRM systems, and campaign management tools to organize data and monitor progress.
* Follow campaign instructions, approved messaging, and communication guidelines.
* Keep outreach messages clear, relevant, professional, and aligned with the intended audience.
* Follow applicable privacy requirements, messaging-platform rules, and consent or opt-out requirements for email and WhatsApp communications.

Experience and Eligibility

**Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply.**

Candidates with previous experience in any of the following areas will be preferred:

* Email marketing and cold email outreach
* WhatsApp marketing and business messaging
* Lead generation and prospect follow-up
* Database marketing and contact-list management
* CRM follow-up and sales support
* Campaign execution and response tracking
* Prospect segmentation and re-engagement campaigns

A specific previous job title is not required. Practical understanding of outreach, attention to detail, written communication, and the ability to maintain organized campaign data are important.

Who Should Apply?

You may be a good fit for this role if you can:

* Write and handle professional business communication.
* Work with contact lists and organize prospects into relevant segments.
* Understand the basics of cold email, WhatsApp outreach, and follow-up sequences.
* Track responses and keep lead statuses updated accurately.
* Identify interested prospects and organize them for further sales follow-up.
* Use spreadsheets, CRM systems, or campaign tools to manage campaign data.
* Avoid duplicate outreach and maintain clean, organized contact records.
* Follow campaign processes consistently while paying attention to communication quality.
* Balance campaign execution speed with relevance, accuracy, and proper data handling.

Key Skills

Email Marketing, WhatsApp Marketing, Cold Email Outreach, WhatsApp Campaign Management, Lead Generation, Follow-Up Sequences, Database Marketing, Contact List Management, Prospect Segmentation, Campaign Execution, Response Tracking, Lead Follow-Up, CRM Management, Spreadsheet Management, Data Management, and Business Communication.

Who Can Apply?

* Freshers interested in email marketing, WhatsApp marketing, or lead generation
* Candidates with experience in cold outreach or campaign execution
* Candidates familiar with spreadsheets, CRM systems, or contact databases
* Candidates who are organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable with structured follow-up work

If you are interested in outbound marketing, campaign execution, and generating business enquiries through organized email and WhatsApp outreach, we encourage you to apply.

Job Title

Executive Director, Growth Marketing

  

Reporting To

Chief Marketing Officer

Company Overview:

Our client is an established healthcare technology and services organisation helping provider organisations improve financial and operational performance. Its combination of specialist expertise, technology-enabled solutions, and collaborative delivery supports complex healthcare organisations across a range of care settings.

SCOPE OF WORK:

Our client is seeking an Executive Director, Growth Marketing to lead its account-based growth strategy, build market awareness, and engage senior decision-makers.

The Executive Director, Growth Marketing will own the strategy and execution model for account-based marketing (ABM), partnering with sales, client success, product marketing, and revenue operations to engage and progress high-value accounts. This leader will oversee integrated campaign execution, manage international marketing execution resources, and lead a team of business development representatives to ensure outreach and account engagement are aligned to revenue priorities. Success will be measured less by lead volume and more by priority account engagement, meetings, and pipeline influence. title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
Job Title: Performance Marketing Specialist / Manager Department: Digital Marketing Experience: Minimum 3 Years Employment Type: Full-Time Work Mode: On-site Location: India Salary: As per experience and industry standards 1. Job Overview We are looking for an experienced, data-driven, and results-oriented Performance Marketing Specialist with a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in planning, executing, optimizing, and scaling paid digital marketing campaigns. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in paid advertising platforms, audience targeting, conversion optimization, performance analytics, and campaign budget management. The candidate will be responsible for driving high-quality traffic, generating leads or conversions, improving return on ad spend (ROAS), and achieving business growth through measurable marketing strategies. The candidate should be comfortable managing multiple campaigns, analyzing performance metrics, conducting experiments, and collaborating with creative, content, SEO, product, and business teams. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Paid Advertising & Campaign Management ● Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), YouTube Ads, and other relevant advertising platforms. ● Develop performance marketing strategies aligned with business objectives, acquisition targets, and revenue goals. ● Manage campaigns across Search, Display, Video, Shopping, App Promotion, remarketing, and lead generation, as applicable. ● Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, audience research, and market analysis to identify growth opportunities. ● Develop audience segmentation strategies based on demographics, interests, intent, behavior, and previous interactions. ● Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns to improve conversion rates and reduce acquisition costs. ● Monitor campaign performance daily and take corrective action to improve results. ● Scale successful campaigns while maintaining target acquisition costs and profitability. B. Budget Planning & Optimization ● Plan and allocate advertising budgets across platforms, campaigns, audiences, and creatives. ● Monitor campaign spending to ensure efficient utilization of allocated budgets. ● Optimize campaigns to achieve target Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Install (CPI), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). ● Identify underperforming campaigns and implement strategies to improve efficiency. ● Forecast campaign performance, expected conversions, and acquisition costs. ● Conduct budget scaling experiments and identify opportunities to increase campaign volume without compromising performance. ● Track revenue, customer acquisition costs, and campaign profitability wherever applicable. C. Data Analytics & Performance Reporting ● Track and analyze campaign metrics, including impressions, reach, clicks, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversions, CPA, CPL, CPI, ROAS, and conversion rates. ● Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports. ● Use Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Looker Studio, and platform-specific dashboards to measure campaign effectiveness. ● Analyze the complete marketing funnel, from impressions and clicks to registrations, leads, purchases, deposits, or other defined business conversions. ● Identify bottlenecks in the conversion funnel and recommend data-backed improvements. ● Develop performance dashboards to monitor campaign health and business KPIs. ● Translate campaign data into actionable insights for management and stakeholders. D. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) ● Analyze landing pages, website journeys, forms, registration flows, and checkout or conversion processes. ● Identify user drop-off points and recommend improvements to increase conversion rates. ● Conduct A/B tests on ad creatives, headlines, landing pages, calls to action, audiences, and campaign structures. ● Collaborate with UI/UX designers, developers, and content teams to improve landing page performance. ● Improve the quality of traffic and ensure advertising campaigns attract relevant users rather than just generating clicks. E. Tracking, Attribution & Technical Implementation ● Set up and validate conversion tracking using Google Tag Manager, GA4, Meta Pixel, and relevant platform conversion APIs. ● Work with developers to implement tracking events, pixels, APIs, and custom conversion events. ● Understand UTM parameters, attribution models, conversion windows, and cross-platform tracking limitations. ● Verify tracking accuracy and troubleshoot discrepancies between advertising platforms and analytics tools. ● Maintain proper campaign naming conventions, UTM structures, and tracking documentation. ● Ensure campaign decisions are based on reliable data and correctly configured conversion events. F. Creative Strategy & Testing ● Work closely with graphic designers, video editors, and content teams to develop high-performing ad creatives. ● Prepare creative briefs for static ads, videos, reels, banners, landing pages, and other advertising formats. ● Analyze creative performance and identify patterns in messaging, formats, hooks, and calls to action. ● Develop a structured creative testing roadmap and regularly introduce new variations. ● Monitor creative fatigue and refresh ads when performance declines. ● Use performance insights to guide future creative production and messaging strategies. G. Growth Strategy & Competitor Research ● Research competitors, industry trends, audience behavior, and advertising opportunities. ● Identify new acquisition channels, audience segments, and campaign formats. ● Develop strategies for customer acquisition, retargeting, retention, and reactivation in coordination with relevant teams. ● Evaluate emerging advertising platforms and marketing technologies where appropriate. ● Collaborate with SEO, social media, product, CRM, and business development teams to support overall growth objectives. H. Compliance & Advertising Policies ● Follow the advertising policies and applicable laws relevant to the business, target markets, and advertising platforms. ● Ensure campaigns, creatives, landing pages, and claims comply with platform requirements. ● Monitor account health, policy warnings, rejected ads, and tracking or delivery issues. ● Maintain transparent reporting and avoid misleading advertising practices. ● For regulated industries, ensure campaigns receive the necessary internal approvals and operate only within permitted advertising policies and jurisdictions. 3. Required Skills & Qualifications ● Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing and paid digital advertising. ● Strong practical experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads. ● Proven experience managing campaign budgets and optimizing campaigns against measurable business KPIs. ● Strong understanding of digital marketing funnels, audience targeting, bidding strategies, remarketing, and conversion optimization. ● Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, and attribution. ● Ability to interpret performance data and make informed optimization decisions. ● Experience preparing campaign reports and performance dashboards. ● Understanding of landing page optimization and A/B testing methodologies. ● Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and time-management skills. ● Ability to manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines in a performance-driven environment. ● Demonstrable results through previous campaigns, case studies, or performance reports. 4. Preferred Qualifications ● Experience with YouTube Ads, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic advertising, or other paid acquisition channels. ● Experience with mobile app acquisition campaigns and app attribution platforms. ● Knowledge of CRM integrations, lead quality analysis, marketing automation, and customer lifecycle marketing. ● Familiarity with Looker Studio, spreadsheets, and advanced campaign reporting. ● Experience in high-volume acquisition, e-commerce, lead generation, gaming, or other conversion-focused industries. ● Experience using AI-powered marketing tools for research, analysis, and creative testing. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated against agreed business objectives, including: ● Achievement of monthly lead, registration, purchase, or acquisition targets. ● Target CPA, CPL, CPI, and ROAS performance. ● Improvement in CTR, conversion rate, and landing page performance. ● Efficient advertising budget utilization. ● Quality of acquired users, leads, or customers. ● Revenue contribution and customer acquisition profitability, where measurable. ● Frequency and quality of campaign testing and optimization. ● Accuracy and timeliness of reporting. ● Compliance with advertising platform policies. Note: KPI targets will be defined according to the business model, campaign maturity, available budget, and market conditions. 6. Experience Requirements Candidates must have at least 3 years of relevant professional experience and should be able to demonstrate: ● Campaigns independently planned, launched, and optimized. ● Advertising budgets managed and the reasoning behind budget allocation decisions. ● Examples of improving conversion rates or reducing acquisition costs. ● Experience troubleshooting tracking or attribution problems. ● Examples of successful creative testing and campaign scaling. ● Clear understanding of the difference between traffic growth, lead generation, conversions, and profitable customer acquisition. Candidates should be prepared to discuss actual campaign results, their individual contributions, and the methods used to achieve those results. 7. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is analytical, proactive, commercially aware, and comfortable taking ownership of campaign performance. They should be able to identify problems independently, propose solutions backed by data, and continuously experiment with new approaches to improve acquisition efficiency. We value practical execution, accountability, strategic thinking, and measurable results over theoretical knowledge alone.

title: Growth & Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description: Growth & Performance Marketing Manager

Company: Adventure Sports Cover360 (ASC360)

Location: Delhi, India

Experience: 3–7+ years

Department: Growth & Digital Marketing

Role Overview

ASC360 is looking for a highly analytical, commercially focused, and execution-driven Growth & Performance Marketing Manager to lead digital customer acquisition, paid marketing, conversion optimization, and revenue growth initiatives.

The role will own the paid acquisition and digital growth engine, from planning and executing advertising campaigns to improving website conversions, generating qualified leads, increasing bookings, and optimizing customer acquisition costs.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, analytics, funnel optimization, and growth experimentation. They should be comfortable managing budgets, interpreting performance data, testing new approaches, and translating marketing insights into measurable business results.

Key Responsibilities

1. Growth Strategy & Ownership

- Develop and execute growth strategies aligned with ASC360’s customer acquisition, booking, and revenue objectives.

- Identify scalable opportunities across paid advertising, retargeting, partnerships, and other relevant digital channels.

- Build monthly and quarterly growth plans with clear targets, budgets, timelines, and performance benchmarks.

- Identify potential customer segments and develop strategies to reach domestic and international audiences.

- Plan and execute growth experiments to improve acquisition efficiency, lead quality, and conversion rates.

- Monitor market trends, competitor campaigns, customer behaviour, and emerging digital marketing opportunities.

- Take ownership of campaign execution, performance analysis, and continuous improvement.

2. Performance Marketing & Paid Advertising

- Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads.

- Develop campaign strategies based on business objectives, customer segments, locations, and stages of the customer journey.

- Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, audience targeting, ad creatives, and campaign structures.

- Build and optimize search, display, remarketing, and other relevant paid campaign formats.

- Develop full-funnel advertising strategies to attract new customers, nurture interested audiences, and drive conversions.

- Collaborate with content and design teams to create effective advertisements, messaging, and landing-page experiences.

- Monitor cost per lead (CPL), customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, return on ad spend (ROAS), and revenue contribution.

- Identify underperforming campaigns, reduce wasted spend, and reallocate budgets toward better-performing audiences and campaigns.

- Conduct regular creative, audience, offer, and campaign experiments to improve results.

- Ensure appropriate conversion tracking and attribution are in place to evaluate campaign performance.

3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

- Analyze website journeys and conversion funnels to identify friction points and opportunities for improvement.

- Optimize landing pages, product pages, enquiry forms, booking flows, calls to action, and other conversion elements.

- Conduct A/B testing and structured experiments to evaluate changes in messaging, design, offers, and user experience.

- Use analytics and user-behaviour insights to understand visitor interactions and reasons for drop-offs.

- Improve the alignment between advertisements, landing pages, customer expectations, and conversion objectives.

- Work with design and development teams to implement and measure website improvements.

- Track the impact of changes on conversion rates, lead quality, booking completion, and revenue.

4. Analytics, Tracking & Reporting

- Establish and maintain reliable measurement frameworks for paid campaigns, website activity, leads, bookings, and revenue.

- Use Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Google Ads reporting, Meta Ads Manager, and other relevant analytics tools.

- Configure and monitor conversion events, campaign tracking, attribution, and performance dashboards.

- Analyze customer acquisition costs, campaign efficiency, audience behaviour, landing-page performance, and conversion funnels.

- Prepare regular reports highlighting key metrics, campaign outcomes, trends, challenges, and recommended actions.

- Identify tracking gaps and reporting discrepancies and coordinate their resolution.

- Use data to determine which campaigns and channels should be optimized, scaled, or discontinued.

- Present actionable performance insights to management and connect marketing investments with business outcomes.

5. Lead Generation & Revenue Growth

- Develop digital acquisition strategies to generate qualified enquiries and increase online bookings.

- Identify opportunities to improve the quality of leads generated through paid campaigns.

- Work with the sales and operations teams to understand lead outcomes, customer requirements, and conversion challenges.

- Analyze the complete funnel from advertisement engagement and website visits to enquiries, bookings, and revenue.

- Develop remarketing and lead-nurturing strategies to re-engage potential customers who have not completed a purchase.

- Identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition efficiency and maximize returns from existing marketing budgets.

- Support the development of campaigns for key products, destinations, adventure activities, and target customer segments.

- Use customer and campaign data to identify opportunities for repeat purchases, cross-selling, and improved customer value where relevant.

6. Campaign Planning & Creative Optimization

- Plan and execute campaigns around business priorities, seasonal demand, destination-specific requirements, and promotional opportunities.

- Develop campaign briefs covering objectives, target audiences, messaging, budget, expected outcomes, and measurement criteria.

- Work with designers, content creators, and other stakeholders to develop compelling ad creatives and campaign assets.

- Test different creative formats, headlines, calls to action, and value propositions.

- Monitor creative fatigue and audience saturation, refreshing campaigns when required.

- Maintain consistency in brand messaging across advertisements, landing pages, and other customer touchpoints.

- Evaluate campaign results and document learnings to improve future initiatives.

7. Collaboration & Execution

- Work closely with management to align growth priorities with business and revenue objectives.

- Coordinate with sales, operations, content, design, and technology teams to execute growth initiatives.

- Translate performance insights into clear action plans with defined priorities and deadlines.

- Manage external agencies, freelancers, and marketing partners where required.

- Maintain structured documentation of campaigns, budgets, experiments, and performance outcomes.

- Take ownership of execution and ensure that identified opportunities translate into measurable improvements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated against agreed business targets, including:

- Qualified leads and online bookings generated.

- Customer acquisition cost (CAC) and cost per lead (CPL).

- Return on ad spend (ROAS) and advertising efficiency.

- Website and landing-page conversion rates.

- Lead-to-booking and visitor-to-customer conversion rates.

- Revenue generated and contribution from paid marketing.

- Campaign performance and budget utilization.

- Improvement in funnel performance and reduction in drop-offs.

- Quality and accuracy of marketing analytics and reporting.

- Timely execution of growth experiments and optimization initiatives.

Targets will be established based on current performance, available budgets, business priorities, and market conditions.

Required Qualifications & Skills

3 to 7 years of relevant experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, paid acquisition, or digital marketing.

- Demonstrated hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.

- Strong understanding of campaign optimization, audience targeting, bidding strategies, and budget allocation.

- Practical experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, advertising dashboards, and conversion tracking.

- Understanding of CAC, CPL, ROAS, attribution, conversion funnels, and revenue measurement.

- Experience optimizing landing pages and improving website conversion rates.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable decisions.

- Experience planning, executing, and evaluating marketing experiments.

- Ability to manage budgets, prioritize initiatives, and work toward measurable targets.

- Strong communication and coordination skills, with a hands-on approach to execution.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in a startup, growth-stage company, or performance-driven business.

- Experience targeting international audiences or managing campaigns across multiple geographies.

- Familiarity with CRM platforms, marketing automation, lead-nurturing systems, and remarketing tools.

- Experience with online bookings, e-commerce, lead-generation platforms, or service-based businesses.

- Experience working with design and development teams on landing-page and funnel improvements.

- Ability to connect marketing performance with customer acquisition, bookings, and commercial outcomes.

Why Join ASC360?

- Ownership: Build and scale ASC360’s paid acquisition and digital growth function.

- Business impact: Directly influence qualified leads, bookings, customer acquisition costs, and revenue.

Hands-on execution: Combine strategic planning with campaign management, testing, and optimization.

- Global opportunities: Help expand ASC360’s reach across domestic and international markets.

- Cross-functional exposure: Work closely with leadership and teams across sales, operations, marketing, and technology.

- Purpose-driven business: Contribute to making adventure activities safer through specialized insurance solutions, medical assistance, and evacuation coordination.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will build a structured, measurable, and scalable growth marketing function for ASC360. They will improve paid acquisition efficiency, generate qualified leads, increase booking conversions, optimize marketing budgets, and establish reliable reporting that connects campaign performance with business results.

We are looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, takes ownership of outcomes, and can turn data, experimentation, and customer insights into sustainable business growth.

* Manage and expand relationships with existing trade and designer partner accounts.

* Monitor outstanding estimates, accepted orders, and accounts receivable; drive timely follow-up and collection in coordination with the finance function.

**Demand Generation**

**Sales Enablement & Reporting**

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* Demonstrated experience managing a CRM-based pipeline with accountability for conversion metrics.
* Working experience with paid social advertising (Meta), with an emphasis on attribution and return on ad spend rather than reach alone.
* Comfortable operating both on the showroom floor with walk-in and trade clients, and independently on reporting and campaign execution.

**SUCCESS MEASURES (FIRST 90 DAYS)**

title: Analyst
description:
**The Role**

As our Analyst, you'll be the analytical engine behind our online sales and paid acquisition. You'll track how every channel performs, find where we're winning or wasting spend, and give marketing, merchandising, and leadership clear recommendations. The role suits someone equally comfortable in a spreadsheet, a SQL editor, and a conversation with a media buyer.

**Compensation**: Indian Rupee $70,000 - $100,000 montly

**What You'll Do**

* Own reporting on ecommerce performance (traffic, conversion rate, AOV, revenue, margin) and paid media (ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR, CPM) across Google, Meta, TikTok, Amazon Ads, affiliates, and other channels.
* Build and maintain dashboards in [Looker Studio / Tableau / Power BI] that give teams a single source of truth.
* Analyze campaign and channel performance, and recommend budget allocation and bid, audience, and creative optimizations.
* Design, run, and read A/B tests on landing pages, site experience, promotions, and ad creative.
* Evaluate attribution across channels using platform data, GA4, and incrementality or MMM approaches where available.
* Analyze customer behavior, including cohorts, retention, lifetime value (LTV), repeat purchase rates, and LTV:CAC by channel.
* Support merchandising and promotional planning with product, category, pricing, and discount performance analysis.
* Forecast revenue and marketing spend for weekly, monthly, and seasonal peaks such as Black Friday/Cyber Monday and holidays.
* Audit tracking and data quality (pixels, UTMs, conversion APIs, GA4 events) with marketing and engineering.
* Present findings to non-technical stakeholders with clear, actionable recommendations.

**What You Bring**

* 2–4 years of experience in ecommerce, digital marketing, or retail analytics.
* Strong SQL skills and advanced Excel/Google Sheets.
* Hands-on experience with GA4 and at least two major ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, Amazon Advertising).
* Experience building dashboards in a BI tool.
* Solid grasp of performance marketing metrics, funnel analysis, and attribution concepts.
* Working knowledge of A/B testing and basic statistics (significance, sample size).
* The ability to explain complex data simply and turn analysis into a clear "here's what we should do."
* Attention to detail and a healthy skepticism about data quality.

**Nice to Have**

* Python or R for analysis or automation.
* Experience with Shopify, Magento/Adobe Commerce, or Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
* Familiarity with marketing mix modeling, incrementality testing, or tools like Northbeam, Triple Whale, or Rockerbox.
