title: Paid Search Manager
description:
**Position Overview**

Vida is looking for an experienced and highly analytical Paid Search Manager to join our growing performance marketing team.

This role will help manage and grow paid search programs across multiple D2C brands within the Vida portfolio. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience managing significant Google Ads budgets across multiple e-commerce accounts and has a proven track record of driving revenue growth and ROAS improvement.

The Paid Search Manager will work closely with the Senior Manager, Paid Search and Director of Paid Media while independently owning day-to-day strategy, execution, optimization, testing, reporting, and performance management across assigned brands.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical Google Ads knowledge with commercial thinking and can identify opportunities to scale revenue while maintaining efficiency.

**Compensation:** Indian Rupee $116,667 - $166,667 montly

**Key Responsibilities**

**Paid Search & Shopping Management**

* Independently manage and optimize paid search programs across multiple D2C/e-commerce brands.
* Build, manage, and optimize campaigns across:
* + Google Search
  + Google Shopping
  + Performance Max
  + Demand Gen
  + Microsoft Ads
* Own campaign performance against revenue, ROAS, conversion, and profitability goals.
* Develop campaign structures and segmentation strategies based on product performance, category, brand, margin, seasonality, and business priorities.
* Conduct product-level performance analysis to identify top-performing products, underperformers, wasted spend, and opportunities to scale.
* Identify opportunities to increase profitable spend while maintaining efficiency targets.
* Monitor competitive activity, search demand, seasonality, promotions, and other factors impacting performance.

**Google Merchant Center & Product Feeds**

* Manage and troubleshoot Google Merchant Center, including product disapprovals, warnings, feed errors, account issues, and product eligibility.
* Work closely with product feeds and feed management platforms to improve Shopping and Performance Max performance.
* Analyze and optimize key feed attributes including product titles, descriptions, product types, Google product categories, custom labels, pricing, availability, images, and promotional information.
* Develop product segmentation strategies using custom labels and other feed attributes.
* Partner with internal teams and feed management partners to continuously improve product data quality and feed health.
* Identify feed optimization opportunities that can improve visibility, traffic quality, revenue, and ROAS.

**Campaign Strategy, Optimization & Performance Analysis**

* Develop keyword and search strategies across brand, non-brand, category, product, competitor, and seasonal campaigns.
* Conduct keyword research, search-term analysis, and negative keyword management to improve traffic quality and efficiency.
* Evaluate and optimize match types, campaign structures, audiences, and account segmentation.
* Develop and manage bidding strategies including Target ROAS, Maximize Conversion Value, Target CPA, Maximize Conversions, and other automated bidding approaches.
* Understand when bidding targets, budgets, campaign structure, or conversion signals may be restricting growth.
* Manage budgets and pacing across assigned accounts while ensuring alignment with monthly and annual revenue goals.
* Recommend budget reallocations across campaigns, products, brands, and tactics based on performance and incremental growth opportunities.
* Develop structured testing roadmaps across bidding, campaign structure, Performance Max, Broad Match, landing pages, ad copy, audiences, feeds, promotions, and emerging Google Ads products.
* Analyze performance across revenue, ROAS, spend, conversion rate, CPA, CPC, average order value, impression share, and other key e-commerce KPIs.
* Diagnose performance changes and clearly communicate what changed, why it changed, and what actions should be taken next.
* Prepare weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting with actionable insights and recommendations.
* Proactively identify performance risks, account issues, testing opportunities, and areas for incremental growth.
* Stay current on Google Ads product updates, automation, AI-driven campaign capabilities, and changes within the paid search landscape.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5–6+ years of hands-on paid search / Google Ads experience, preferably within an agency, multi-brand organization, or D2C/e-commerce business.
* Strong experience independently managing multiple paid search accounts simultaneously.
* Demonstrated experience managing significant paid media budgets and being accountable for revenue and ROAS goals.
* Strong D2C/e-commerce experience with an understanding of how paid search contributes to overall business growth.
* Advanced hands-on knowledge of:
* + Google Search
  + Google Shopping
  + Performance Max
  + Demand Gen
  + Google Merchant Center
  + Microsoft Advertising
* Advanced understanding of Google Smart Bidding, including Target ROAS and value-based bidding strategies.
* Strong experience with Shopping campaign structures, product segmentation, and product-level performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience working with Google Merchant Center and product feeds.
* Strong understanding of campaign structures, match types, keyword strategy, search-term analysis, and negative keyword management.
* Ability to determine when performance issues are driven by bidding, budget, feed quality, campaign structure, conversion rate, tracking, competition, seasonality, or other factors.
* Strong understanding of e-commerce KPIs including revenue, ROAS, conversion rate, CPA, AOV, CPC, impression share, and profitability.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex performance data into actionable recommendations.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to QA campaign setups, budgets, conversion tracking, feeds, URLs, promotions, and account changes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple brands, projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to proactively bring recommendations and growth opportunities rather than relying solely on direction from senior leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with D2C retail, footwear, fashion, apparel, accessories, or consumer brands.
* Experience managing large e-commerce product catalogs and Shopping-heavy accounts.
* Experience managing high-spend Google Ads accounts.
* Experience with third-party feed management platforms such as Feedonomics, Productsup, DataFeedWatch, Channable, or similar platforms.
* Experience developing custom-label and product segmentation strategies.
* Understanding of GA4, conversion tracking, attribution, enhanced conversions, and e-commerce measurement.
* Experience managing Microsoft Ads alongside Google Ads.
* Experience with Performance Max channel analysis and understanding the interaction between Search, Shopping, YouTube, Display, and other inventory within PMax.
* Experience evaluating new customer acquisition, brand vs. non-brand performance, and incremental growth opportunities.
* Familiarity with Looker Studio or other reporting and visualization platforms.

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful Paid Search Manager will be able to independently own assigned accounts while consistently identifying opportunities to improve performance and grow the business.

Success in this role means:

* Growing profitable revenue across assigned brands.
* Meeting or exceeding ROAS and business performance targets.
* Identifying opportunities to scale high-performing campaigns, categories, and products.
* Quickly diagnosing and addressing performance declines.
* Effectively managing significant budgets and maintaining accurate pacing.
* Continuously improving Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and product feed strategies.
* Developing thoughtful testing roadmaps with clear hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
* Turning account and product data into clear strategic recommendations.
* Maintaining strong Merchant Center and feed health.
* Proactively identifying new opportunities rather than waiting for direction.
* Clearly communicating account performance, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions to the Senior Manager, Paid Search.
* Taking strong ownership of assigned brands while collaborating effectively across the broader performance marketing team.

description:
**Life at** 
**TrackoBit**
--------------------------

We, at TrackoBit, take our work seriously and that last slice of pizza more seriously. We are a bunch of technogeeks with a knack for creativity. The environment at our office is anything but dull. We always look for passionate professionals who love their work and impart positive energy. -------------------------

- **Content Lead**
  ----------------

  ###### **Number Of Position :- 1**

  * **Department** **– Marketing**

  ### **THE ROLE**

  We are looking for a Content Lead who can run a content engine, not just write well. You will own the content roadmap across all three products, raise the quality of a team of writers, and produce content that business decision-makers trust and that moves pipeline. You will work closely with the Content Manager, product, sales, design and growth teams.

  This is a 12-month contract-to-hire role. It suits someone who wants real ownership from day one and who is confident that their work will speak for itself. Conversion to a permanent role is based on performance and business fit.

  ### **WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

  * **Content strategy and roadmap:** Build and run the editorial calendar across TrackoBit, TrackoField and TrackoMile, tied to audience, search intent and business goals.
  * **Team leadership:** Guide, mentor and review a team of writers. Set the quality bar for tone, structure, accuracy and depth, and get work approved with fewer revision rounds.
  * **High-impact content:** Create and oversee landing pages, long-form blogs, case studies, whitepapers, email copy and product messaging. Where it matters, write the flagship pieces yourself.
  * **Complex tech to clear messaging:** Turn GPS telematics, field workforce automation and delivery logistics into content that a fleet owner, operations head or CXO finds clear and credible.
  * **SEO and performance:** Use keyword research, search intent and analytics (traffic, CTR, engagement, conversions) to decide what to write, what to fix and what to retire.
  * **Content ROI:** Co-own the measurement of what content delivers in leads, pipeline and revenue influence, and report it clearly.
  * **Brand voice:** Keep messaging consistent across all three products and every channel.
  * **Cross-functional partnership:** Work with product, sales, support, design and growth to keep content accurate, on-brand and campaign-ready. Align with the social media team as needed.
  * **Fresh thinking:** Bring in new formats, ideas and smart use of AI tools to increase output without lowering quality.

  ### **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

  * **First 30 days:** Audit existing content, map keyword and messaging gaps, and understand all three products and their buyers.
  * **First 90 days:** A working editorial calendar, a clear review process for the team, and visible gains in content quality and turnaround time.
  * **By month 6 to 12:** Measurable impact on organic traffic, lead quality and content-attributed pipeline, and a team that can deliver without heavy rewrites.

  ### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

  * 6+ years of B2B content experience (IT/SaaS preferred), with at least 5 years directly relevant
  * At least 2 years of managing or mentoring writers
  * Excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills, with a strong eye for clarity and accuracy
  * Solid grasp of content strategy, SEO and conversion copywriting
  * Comfort with analytics and the ability to link content to business outcomes
  * Ability to work in a fast-moving environment with multiple stakeholders, including senior leadership
  * A portfolio of published work you can walk us through

  **Bonus:** experience in fleet management, field force or logistics domains; hands-on use of AI tools in content workflows; CRM or product marketing content.

  Graduate in any discipline (English, Journalism, Communications or Marketing preferred).

  ### **WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT**

  * You own content for products used by industry leaders, and your work is read by real buyers
  * You lead a team and shape how content is run, rather than following a set playbook
  * You are measured on outcomes, and strong performance leads to a permanent seat

title: Public Relation Officer
description:
A **Public Relations (PR) Officer** acts as the voice and ambassador of an organization. Their primary goal is to build, maintain, and protect a positive public image, cultivate good relationships with media and key stakeholders, and manage communication during key announcements or crises.

Key ResponsibilitiesMedia Relations & PR Strategy

* **Press Releases & Media Kits:** Write, edit, and distribute clear press releases, media advisories, pitch letters, and press kits.
* **Media Outreach:** Establish and nurture long-term relationships with journalists, reporters, editors, and influencers.
* **Spokesperson Coordination:** Organize press conferences, media briefings, interviews, and media tours; prepare spokespeople with briefing documents and talking points.

Content & Communications Strategy

* **Corporate Content:** Draft speeches for executives, company newsletters, annual reports, corporate blogs, and official statements.
* **Brand Storytelling:** Craft compelling brand narratives to highlight product launches, community engagement, and strategic milestones.
* **Social Media & Digital PR:** Collaborate with social media and marketing teams to ensure brand messaging is consistent across digital channels.

Reputation & Crisis Management

* **Crisis Communication:** Develop and execute crisis management plans to handle negative publicity, scandals, or operational emergencies quickly and effectively.
* **Brand Monitoring:** Track news coverage, industry developments, and social media sentiment to proactively address potential reputation risks.

Internal Communications & Events

* Stakeholder EngagementA **Public Relations (PR) Officer** acts as the voice and brand ambassador of an organization. Their primary responsibility is to build, maintain, and manage a positive public image and reputation for the company, client, or institution they represent.

Here is a comprehensive overview of the typical job description, duties, qualifications, and skills for a PR Officer.

Job Overview

* **Job Title:** Public Relations Officer (PR Officer) / Communications Specialist
* **Reports To:** Head of Communications / PR Manager / Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)
* **Job Purpose:** To develop and implement effective communication and media strategies that enhance brand reputation, manage public perception, and engage key stakeholders.

Core Responsibilities & Key Duties1. Media Relations & Press Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact for media outlets, journalists, and news organizations.
* Write, edit, and distribute press releases, media advisories, and press kits.
* Pitch story ideas and features to journalists to secure positive media coverage.
* Organize and manage press conferences, interviews, and media events.

2. Reputation & Crisis Management

title: Field Marketing Manager
description:
**Location**
------------

New Delhi, India; Mumbai, India

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
-----------------

Hybrid

**Department**
--------------

All Cost CenterMarketingDemand Gen

  

**Are you ready to unlock intelligence?**

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

**Build Kong’s India marketing engine from the ground up.**

**The opportunity**
-------------------

Kong is the AI connectivity company. We help engineering teams manage, secure, and scale the APIs and AI traffic that power modern businesses.

India represents a significant growth opportunity for Kong. We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager to build our marketing presence in the market from the ground up—turning strategic priorities into programs that create demand, accelerate pipeline, and establish Kong as a leader in API and AI connectivity.

This is a builder’s role. There’s no established playbook, inherited marketing engine, or existing team to lean on. You’ll have the ownership to define the strategy, make the bets, build the programs, and prove what works.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, global marketing, and channel partners to bring Kong’s story to India’s enterprise technology leaders. You’ll be expected to think strategically, execute hands-on, and connect every marketing investment to measurable business outcomes.

**Your mission: build a repeatable, scalable marketing engine that drives growth for Kong in India.**

**What you’ll do**
------------------

### **Own the India marketing strategy**

* Define the regional marketing strategy, priorities, and investment plan in alignment with India Sales and global marketing.
* Identify the industries, enterprise accounts, and buyer segments with the greatest growth potential.
* Turn market insights into focused programs that generate pipeline and accelerate revenue.
* Make deliberate choices about where to invest—and where not to.

### **Build and execute account-based marketing**

* Partner with Sales to develop and prioritize target account lists, buying groups, and account-specific growth strategies.
* Design and execute ABM programs that engage decision-makers, build buying-group awareness, and create opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Coordinate campaigns, executive engagement, content, and field activities around account priorities.
* Measure account engagement, opportunity creation, pipeline influence, and progression through the sales cycle.

### **Create demand that converts**

* Build integrated demand generation programs across digital, content, email, events, and partner channels.
* Translate Kong’s global messaging into locally relevant campaigns that resonate with India’s enterprise technology buyers.
* Work with Sales to define lead qualification, routing, follow-up SLAs, and conversion targets.
* Continuously optimize programs based on pipeline contribution, conversion rates, and cost efficiency.

### **Build the India events engine**

* Develop an events strategy spanning executive roundtables, technical workshops, webinars, industry conferences, and flagship experiences.
* Create programs that bring together engineering leaders, enterprise decision-makers, developers, and strategic customers.
* Own event planning, audience acquisition, execution, follow-up, and performance measurement.
* Build a repeatable events model that prioritizes meaningful engagement and commercial outcomes over attendance numbers alone.

### **Turn partnerships into growth**

* Work with channel and technology partners to develop joint demand generation and co-marketing programs.
* Equip partners with localized content, campaigns, event resources, and sales enablement.
* Identify opportunities to extend Kong’s reach through strategic ecosystems and industry relationships.

### **Establish Kong’s presence in India**

* Adapt global brand campaigns and content for local market needs while maintaining consistency with Kong’s positioning.
* Build relationships with relevant industry communities, technology leaders, and enterprise decision-makers.
* Develop programs that strengthen awareness, credibility, and consideration among Kong’s target audiences.

### **Own the budget and prove impact**

* Manage the India field marketing budget, allocating investment against clear business priorities.
* Establish dashboards and reporting that connect marketing activity to qualified pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.
* Share performance transparently, including what worked, what didn’t, and what should change.
* Build a continuous improvement culture grounded in data, experimentation, and accountability.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* **A builder’s mindset.** You’ve built a marketing function, regional program, or demand engine from scratch—not just operated an established one.
* **B2B technology marketing experience.** You understand how to market complex technology solutions to enterprise buyers and translate technical value into business impact.
* **Strong ABM and demand generation expertise.** You know how to prioritize accounts, engage buying groups, generate demand, and build programs that contribute to pipeline.
* **A track record in high-growth environments.** You’re comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities, limited resources, and the need to move quickly.
* **Cross-functional leadership.** You can align Sales, global marketing, partners, and regional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* **Events that deliver results.** You know how to design experiences that build relationships, create opportunities, and justify the investment.
* **Commercial and analytical rigor.** You understand pipeline metrics, conversion rates, campaign performance, and marketing efficiency—and know how to act on the data.
* **Deep knowledge of India’s enterprise technology landscape.** You understand the accounts, industries, buying dynamics, and ecosystems that matter.
* **Clear, adaptable communication.** You can build credibility with engineers, executives, sales teams, and marketing leaders alike.

**What will set you apart**
---------------------------

* Experience marketing APIs, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, cybersecurity, or AI technologies.
* Experience building channel marketing or partner-led demand generation programs.
* Established relationships across India’s enterprise technology, financial services, or global capability center (GCC) ecosystem.
* Experience working in a global, matrixed organization while building programs tailored to a regional market.

#LI-NS1

**About Kong:**

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

title: Executive-Marketing
description:
**Marketing Executive**

*Detailed Job Description — Infozech*

**Location:**Mohan Cooperative, New Delhi | Experience: 3 years |Full-time

**Industry:**B2B Technology — Telecom & Tower Software & Solutions

**About Infozech**

Infozech is a leading technology solution provider to large telecom operators and tower companies worldwide, helping towercos, MNOs, and enterprises optimize operations with data-driven insights. We are looking for a dynamic, AI-fluent Marketing Executive to strengthen our brand, automate our marketing engine, and generate demand — someone who treats AI as the default way to work smarter across content, search, and campaigns.

**How We Think About Content & Campaigns**

**This is not a volume role.** Success is not measured by how much content is produced, but by how deeply it resonates with the CXOs and functional heads of large telecom and tower companies. Every asset starts from a real pain point these leaders face, positions Infozech's solutions as the answer, and is engineered — in format and distribution — to reach influential decision-makers and convert their attention into enquiries and demand. Quality of resonance and distribution matter more than quantity.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI-Driven Marketing & Workflow Automation**

* Design and build, run, and improve AI-linked marketing workflows — automating campaign curation, orchestration, scheduling, and lifecycle management end to end.
* Use AI to sharpen content, SEO, AEO, thought leadership, and campaigns — from ideation and drafts to optimization, formatting, and repurposing for distribution.
* Automate repetitive operations — nurture sequences, segmentation, tagging, reporting — so time is freed for what actually moves CXOs.

**2. Pain-Point Content & CXO Storytelling**

* Start from the real pain points of CXOs and functional heads of towercos and telecom operators, and craft narratives that position Infozech's solutions and capabilities as the answer.
* Storyboard, ideate, draft, and proofread across blogs, case studies, whitepapers, newsletters, and social posts — aligned to Infozech's brand voice and industry context.
* Write pain-first, curiosity-led B2B copy that is credible and skimmable for busy senior leaders.

**3. AEO & SEO (AI-Linked Search Visibility)**

* AEO: structure and format content so Infozech surfaces in AI-generated answers, generative search, snippets, and LLM responses — via question-led formats, structured data, and entity clarity.
* SEO: keyword research, on-page and meta-tag optimization, technical hygiene, and Google Business Profile (GMB) ratings and listings.
* Render every asset for easier, better distribution — the right format, structure, and metadata so it travels well to the people who matter.

**4. Campaigns & Demand Generation**

* Build sharply targeted, pain-point-led campaigns aimed at CXOs and functional heads — not broad-reach noise, but narratives that name a real problem and position Infozech as the solution.
* Engineer how each asset is rendered and distributed so it reaches influential people in the format most likely to land — and track how it converts into enquiries and qualified demand.
* Use automation to curate and manage the campaign lifecycle — audience building, sequencing, delivery, follow-up — so targeting and timing stay precise at scale.
* Measure success by resonance and demand generated (enquiries, conversations, pipeline), not content volume.

**5. Collaboration, Social & CRM**

* Interview product, presales, sales, the CEO, and product owners to co-create credible content grounded in real customer problems; partner with design for collateral.
* Run LinkedIn-led thought leadership and social engagement for senior telecom/towerco audiences, and promote events and webinars.
* Execute targeted email campaigns (Zoho CRM, Mailchimp), nurture and qualify leads with sales, and keep the marketing database clean.

**6. Market Research & Competitive Analysis**

* Research market trends, competitors, and — above all — the evolving pain points of telecom and towerco leaders; track performance and recommend differentiation.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

BBA, B.Tech, MBA, or a degree in Journalism, English, Communication, or an equivalent field. 3 years in B2B marketing, preferably in technology, SaaS, or telecom.

**Technical (in order of priority)**

* **AI & Automation —** using AI to automate content, SEO, AEO, thought leadership, and campaigns.
* **Content & Storytelling —** pain-point-led storyboarding, blog ideation, drafting, proofreading for a senior audience.
* **SEO & AEO —** keyword suggestions, meta tags, structured data, GMB, extended into AEO for AI-driven search and distribution.
* **Campaigns & Analytics —** brainstorming and structuring campaigns that generate demand; competitor analysis and performance tracking.
* **Creative Collaboration —** interviewing product, presales, sales, CEO, and product owners to create content.
* **Social & Email —** social media (creating, posting, engagement, event promotion); email campaigns and tools (Zoho, Mailchimp).
* **Communication, Org & Tools —** strong written and verbal English; content calendars and multi-project management; MS Office and design tools (Canva, Adobe) a plus.

**Behavioural**

* Proactive, self-motivated, and an innovative, creative problem-solver; high integrity and open to feedback; focused and organized; a quick learner, confident speaker, collaborative team player, and analytical and data-driven.

**Preferred Experience & Why Join**

* Hands-on experience applying AI tools to content, search, or campaign workflows.
* A track record of content or campaigns that generated enquiries or engaged senior decision-makers — not just published volume.
* Understanding of telecom infrastructure, energy management, or enterprise SaaS is a plus.
* Lead impactful, AI-first marketing that reaches the decision-makers of the world's largest telecom and tower companies — and drives measurable demand.

title: Senior Manager, Community, Advocacy and Partnerships
description:
Circa:


Salary is competitive.


The Royal Society of Chemistry is a not\-for\-profit organisation whose mission is to advance chemical sciences. As a not\-for\-profit publisher, we reinvest surplus funds back into the global scientific community, supporting our purpose to help the chemical science community to create a future that is more open and more equal. We work closely with public authorities, universities and schools.


We are looking for an experienced Leader in publishing to join us as a **Senior Manager, Community, Advocacy and Strategic Partnerships** . In this role you will be a Growth Accelerator in identifying new opportunities and partnerships with our key external stakeholders. You will continue building and developing strong relationships with government and policy bodies, ONOS, Inflibnet, private and public universities across the region to strengthen our existing position in the market.


In this role you will be the one who will develop and deliver unified community engagement and partnership strategy across India and South Asia, helping to expand the reach, visibility and impact of the Royal Society of Chemistry's activities.


As the strategic lead for community outreach, advocacy and institutional partnerships, you will bring together engagement activities into a coordinated, year\-round programme focused on delivering measurable outcomes and long\-term impact. You will work closely with colleagues across Editorial, Memberships, Sales and Marketing to align engagement initiatives with organisational priorities and increase awareness and use of RSC content and services, while maximising opportunities through national initiatives such as ONOS.


This is a very exciting opportunity for an experienced leader with a strong understanding of scientific publishing, research and higher education landscape across India and South Asia, including open science, open access, research funding and science policy.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Set and own the India and South Asia community, advocacy and strategic partnerships strategy, defining regional priorities, maintaining a forward roadmap and aligning activity, resource and investment to RSC’s global purpose and long\-term goals.
* Strengthen RSC’s position in ONOS, INFLIBNET, open access and APC revenue opportunities by building priority partnerships, supporting platform and journal adoption, and working with Head of Sales on pilots, lighthouse wins and monetised partnerships.
* Oversee the planning and delivery of major events and engagement activity, including setting agendas with partners and briefing or involving RSC Senior Leadership for priority activity such as sustainability and CRSI\-related events.
* Create a collaborative team environment that encourages open communication, knowledge sharing and joined\-up delivery across internal and external partners.
* Translate global and regional priorities for open science, open access, sustainable chemistry, inclusion, research culture and scientific impact into clear plans, flagship activity and workstreams with defined owners, timelines and governance.
* Own senior engagement with research communities through structured stakeholder mapping, targeted programmes and relationship management across PhD students, postdoctoral researchers, early career researchers, authors, reviewers, academics, institutions and senior scientific leaders.
* Set the regional policy and sector insight agenda by monitoring developments across science, research, higher education, publishing and the funder ecosystem, assessing implications for RSC and producing clear recommendations, briefings and internal updates.
* Build and steward strategic relationships with government, funders, academic institutions, research networks, innovation clusters, startups, incubators, sector bodies and other priority partners through clear engagement plans and partnership objectives.
* Set the strategic engagement approach for librarians, consortia, academic influencers and state and central universities, strengthening awareness, adoption and effective use of RSC platforms, products, journals and books across priority institutions.
* Communicate priorities, expectations and decisions clearly, ensuring direct reports and stakeholders understand responsibilities, objectives and how their work contributes to the wider strategy.
* Work with relevant internal stakeholders to deliver major outreach, advocacy, partnership and market development programmes, including sustainability, DEI, women in chemistry, open science and open access activity.
* Ensure programmes are well governed and properly resourced through clear budgets, risk controls, supplier oversight, decision governance, delivery reviews, operational delivery standards and post\-programme evaluation.
* Act as the regional point of influence for community, advocacy and partnership insight, helping Editorial, Sales, Membership, Marketing and relevant Global Impact Group teams align priorities and delivery.

**Requirements:**

* Degree or Master’s level education in science, or equivalent practical experience, with significant senior\-level experience in community engagement, advocacy, policy, partnerships or scientific outreach.
* Strong understanding of the Indian and South Asian research, higher education, science policy, funder, publishing, open access, open science or chemistry community landscape.
* Proven ability to set direction, shape strategy and lead complex regional engagement, advocacy or partnership plans.
* Experience building senior relationships with academic leaders, policymakers, funders, government bodies, librarians, research institutions and sector partners.
* Strong policy judgement, communication, advocacy and influencing skills, including clear recommendations for senior audiences.
* Experience leading major programmes, including budgets, governance, procurement, supplier oversight, risk management, evaluation, impact reporting and ROI.
* Commercial awareness, including business case development, value for money, revenue growth opportunities, cost recovery, sponsorship or co\-funding where relevant.

At the Royal Society of Chemistry, we support flexibility and offer hybrid working, which means our teams come together when they need to collaborate.
 

Although this role is contractually based at our Delhi office, and therefore you will have the opportunity to work mostly from any other location in India, as agreed with your line manager. Applicants should be aware that there is an expectation that employees will attend our Delhi office once a month. Please be aware that in this role you are expected to travel across India for events or meetings with our external partners.


This role will close on 27th September at 23\.59 (local time). The interviews will be held via Teams on the **1st and 2nd October** . If you are interested in this role, please apply before the end of the closing date. When applying, you will need to provide an up\-to\-date CV and a supporting statement (no more than 500 words) indicating how your skills/ expertise match the competencies outlined in the Job Description.

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and responsible **Cycle Count Auditor** to manage and perform regular inventory cycle counts and audits at the warehouse.The role will be responsible for physically verifying inventory against system records, identifying discrepancies, investigating the root cause, and ensuring accurate inventory records. The candidate should have strong attention to detail and be comfortable working in a fast\-paced warehouse environment.**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct **daily/weekly cycle counts** as per the defined audit plan.
* Physically count and verify inventory across assigned bins and locations.
* Match physical inventory with **system inventory** and identify any discrepancies.
* Verify SKU, product quantity, batch, expiry, MRP and other relevant inventory details.
* Identify and report **shortage, excess, damaged, misplaced and suspicious inventory**.
* Ensure that all inventory found on the warehouse floor is properly accounted for and highlighted during the audit.
* Investigate inventory mismatches and coordinate with the concerned teams for resolution.
* Identify the **RCA (Root Cause Analysis)** for recurring inventory discrepancies.
* Maintain proper documentation of all cycle count observations and discrepancies.
* Prepare and share daily/weekly cycle count reports with accurate remarks and supporting details.
* Ensure that pending discrepancies are followed up and closed within the defined timeline.
* Re\-audit bins/SKUs wherever required after corrective action.
* Coordinate with Inventory, Operations, QC, Putaway and other relevant teams for inventory accuracy.
* Ensure proper adherence to warehouse SOPs and inventory control processes.
* Escalate critical or recurring discrepancies to the reporting manager on priority.
* Support inventory audits, stock verification and other inventory\-related activities as required.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Inventory accuracy**
* Cycle count completion as per defined schedule
* Accuracy of physical vs. system inventory
* Timely identification and closure of discrepancies
* Quality and accuracy of audit reports
* Timely RCA and corrective action tracking
* Reduction in recurring inventory discrepancies
* Compliance with inventory audit SOPs

**Required Skills**

* Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Basic understanding of warehouse and inventory processes.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel / Google Sheets**.
* Ability to identify discrepancies and investigate their causes.
* Good documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate with multiple teams.
* Good communication and follow\-up skills.
* Willingness to work on the warehouse floor and perform physical inventory counts.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced operational environment.

**Educational Qualification**

* Minimum **12th pass**; graduate preferred.
* Candidates with experience in warehouse, inventory, stock audit, cycle count or operations will be preferred.

**Preferred Experience**Candidates with experience in any of the following areas will be preferred:

* Warehouse Inventory
* Cycle Counting
* Stock Audit
* Inventory Reconciliation
* Warehouse Operations
* FMCG / E\-commerce / D2C warehouse operations

**Working days: Monday \- Saturday**

**Location: khasra no. 286, Lal kuawn , Mehrauli badarpur road, Vishwakarma colont,Delhi**

title: Brand Marketing Manager
description:
**Designation**\- Brand Marketing Manager
  

  

**Experience** \- 5 Years
  

  

**Position Description** – Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it's equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you.
  

In the capacity of a Brand Marketing Manager, you will ensure the efficient execution of business plans to meet future brand expectations and targets. You will also take part in the development of short\-term tactical Brand Management marketing plans. You will ensure brand integrity by guiding efforts across multiple channels and functions and support the development and execution of offline, digital, and paid social advertising programs for the business.
  

The role entails the management of media campaigns from the beginning to the end and is also responsible for the execution across all media channels inclusive of TV, Radio, Digital, Print, and Paid Social. The Brand Marketing Manager reports directly to the Director\- Womennovator.
  

  

**The Impact You'll Make in this Role** \-
  

  

**Strategy :** You will play part in the development of the brand marketing strategies in order to establish strategic direction and program positioning. In this capacity, the Brand Marketing Manager, you will develop marketing partnerships with media partners, and other external partners in an attempt to broaden the reach of the business’s brand messaging.
  

You will also play part in the development and execution of paid social programs on advertising platforms inclusive of Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest, and Twitter etc. along with supporting the brand’s paid media programs. At this capacity, you will contribute to the development and execution of all online/offline events, promotions for the business/brand.
  

  

**Management:** You will play a managerial role in the production process for all offline marketing materials, for example, project timelines, and so forth. You will be tasked with the maintenance of the lower department’s operational production budget, ensuring that there is a continuous effective and economical allocation of resources. You will also supervises multiple external agencies in developing creative advertising, high\-impact promotions, and media planning,event sponsorship.
  

You will additionally manage media timelines and executes plans across all media channels, that is, TV, Social, Radio, and Print etc. you will effectively supervisethe junior marketing staff/team, managing workflow, providing direction, and overseeing constant skill development. You will strike a balance in ensuring all branding and key information strategies are in line with overall business strategy without compromising the brand’s integrity.
  

  

**Collaboration:** You will work closely with Director, in reviewing and approving all branded elements for advertising and launch materials inclusive of printed collateral, product packaging, online assets, launch toolkits, product logos, and videos etc..
  

In this collaboration, he/she also provides feedback and insight on the performance of program campaigns and relays them for further strategic development and solution formulation. You will serves as a collaborative partner and liaison between all internal product departments in ensuring integrated campaigns and cohesive strategies. Youwill also be tasked with collaborating with external partners in ensuring that all media plans are aligned with the business’s values and goals, are executed on\-time and on\-budget.
  

  

**Analytics:** You will also play an analytical role where you will conduct research and analyses, translating campaign performance into communication documents and reports, which are distributed to management and key stakeholders. Some of these documents are marketing briefs, competitive analyses, campaign recap decks, and so forth.
  

At this capacity, You will track spending on all media campaigns for the purpose of ensuring that brand marketing efforts always stay within the allocated budget. Here, you will actualize cost reports per project at the completion of each brand marketing campaign. You will prepare account management, expenditure, progress, and other related reports. Additionally, you will review targeted spends and make real\-time adjustments to optimize brand marketing campaign performance.
  

  

**Knowledge and Opportunity:** You will also conduct regular and consistent research and keep the business and the brand marketing department informed on best practices and the latest trends in brand marketing that ensure that the business does not lag behind of its competition and also in order to provide growth opportunity for the brand by capitalizing on the acquisition potential that alternative branding strategies/approaches may hold.
  

At this capacity, you will ensure that the product/service maintains a consistent tone that is relevant to the business’s brand and the audience, solidifying the brand identity by ensuring consistent, on\-time and accurate development, deliveryfor each brand marketing campaign.
  

  

**Other Duties:** You will also performs other tasks as designated by the Director.
  

  

**To set you up for success in this role from day one, Womennovator is looking for candidates who must have the following qualifications:**  

  

  

* MBA or Master's Degree in Marketing (Completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited university


* Five (5\) combined years’ experience in brand management or integrated marketing


* Three (3\) years people leadership experience


* Strong communications (written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal) skills, including tact, diplomacy, and ability to influence and navigate across a diverse and complex organization.


* Highly proficient in Ms Word, PowerPoint, and Ms Excel


  

**Age:** Preferably below 35 years as on the closing date for receipt of application
